lyrics:
[Intro: fuzz bass riff, stomp-clap, crowd shouting hey]

[Verse 1: swaggering male voice, dry]
Bought the big TV, mounted it myself
Trophies and a bottle on the top shelf
Did it all, got it all, checked every box
Come home at night to the ticking of the clocks

[Chorus: stomp-clap, bluesy, sneering]
Still empty (hey!) what a joke
Still empty (hey!) all that smoke
Filled it up with everything I found
Still an echo when I walk around
Every room, every drawer, every night
Still empty

[Verse 2: voice sharper, guitars in]
Then I heard about a hole in a hill outside a town
Sealed with a boulder, soldiers all around
Friday they buried him, and that was that
Sunday the women came running back

[Chorus: triumphant, full gang, major lift]
Still empty! (Hey!) Go and check
Still empty! (Hey!) Nobody's there yet
Two thousand years they've been digging around
Nobody's found a body in that ground
Best news I ever heard in my life
Still empty!

[Bridge: breakdown, bass and claps, then everyone]
My house was empty and it nearly killed me
His grave is empty and it finally filled me
He's alive (he's alive!), he's alive (he's alive!)
Jesus is alive!

[Final Chorus: loudest, crowd on every line]
Still empty! (Hey!) Go and check
Still empty! (Hey!) Nobody's there yet
Two thousand years they've been digging around
Nobody's found a body in that ground
Best news I ever heard in my life
Still empty!

[Outro: fuzz riff, crowd cheering, one last stomp]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 124 BPM, 4/4, E minor, with the second and later choruses harmonised in E major. A stomping garage-rock strut that turns into a stadium chant.

VOICE: Male, mid-range, dry and swaggering in verse 1, with a sneer in the first chorus. From verse 2 he sings with rising excitement, and a large crowd shouts 'hey!' and then every chorus line with him.

INSTRUMENTS: A fuzzed-out bass riff, stomps and handclaps as the main beat, a loud kick and snare from verse 2, a gritty electric guitar doubling the riff, tambourine, organ stabs in the triumphant choruses.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, fuzz riff and stomp-clap. 0:10 Verse 1. 0:32 Chorus 1, the lament. 0:58 Verse 2, the tomb. 1:20 Chorus 2, the triumph. 1:46 Bridge, breakdown and chant. 2:14 Final chorus. 2:42 Outro, riff, cheering and a last stomp at 3:06.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Garage rock built for arenas: raw, loud, dry, the crowd as big as the band.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The chorus at 1:20, the same two words as before with the opposite meaning and the chords turned major.

THE REVEAL: Verse 1 and chorus one are a rich man's empty house. Verse 2 at 0:58 is the sealed tomb, and chorus two says it is still empty. The bridge spells out the contrast in two lines and shouts that Jesus is alive.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Hollow, bitter, startled, exultant.
